blueprints.name: Basic Wheat Farm
blueprints.description: A small hoed-and-watered wheat field. Cheap, low risk, feeds a handful of citizens.

blueprints.name: Expanded Multi-Crop Farm
blueprints.description: Adds carrots and potatoes alongside wheat for more resilient food production.

blueprints.name: Basic Iron Golem Farm
blueprints.description: A simple villager-hut iron farm producing a slow but steady iron trickle.

guides.topic: Farming basics for a young city
steps: Prioritize a basic_farm as soon as a city has 2+ gatherers.
Upgrade to expanded_farm once population exceeds 8 to avoid starvation penalties.
Keep at least 2x the city's per-cycle food consumption in reserve as a buffer.
